help.title: How to command
help.talk.body: You are Hammer. You never act on a unit directly: you call a station on the radio and it decides how to carry out the order. Type a call in the box and send it (Enter, or the Send button), or hold the microphone button (on a keyboard, the ` key), speak, and release: the call is sent as soon as it is transcribed. Picking a squad on the map, then a point, then Hold, Move or Attack writes the call for you; with a squad picked, a spoken order that names nobody goes to it. On a keyboard, Up and Down in the box bring back earlier calls. Call Anvil, your operator, for anything that is not one squad's job.
help.attack.say: Viper 1, this is Hammer. Attack Foxtrot. Over.
help.upgrade: Give a squad a smarter brain
help.all.say: All stations, this is Hammer. Attack Zulu. Over.
help.strict.1: A callsign and the order are enough, and a callsign that is only spelled or heard roughly right is corrected. With no callsign, Anvil gets the message.
help.strict.2: Every call opens with who you are calling and who you are: "Viper 1, this is Hammer."
help.strict.3: Full procedure: the opening call, and Over or Out at the end. Anything else is refused.
help.more.body: Black ground has never been seen, dim ground was seen earlier, and clear ground is in sight of your troops right now. Land rigs are captured by infantry and sea rigs by boats; each one pumps gold. You win by destroying the enemy headquarters or by holding more points when the clock runs out.

help.ex.intro: Pick an example to put it in the radio box, then change the names and send it.
help.manage.say: Anvil, run the fight. Take Bravo and Delta, keep one squad on the headquarters, and buy tanks when we can afford them.

brains.title: Who thinks for your squads
brains.server: Your squads are run by this server's agents.
brains.relay: Your squads think in this browser ({count} agents), through your {provider} key ending in {hint}.
brains.demo: Your squads run the demo brain in this browser ({count} agents). It uses no AI.
brains.standby: This browser is standing by: another one is already running your squads.
brains.nokey: No key is set for this seat.
brains.norelay: This server has no model relay, so a key cannot be used here.
brains.where: The key goes to this game's relay and nowhere else. It is stored there encrypted and is never shown again, not even to you: only its last characters. Your squads' thinking is then billed to you by your provider, and each squad uses the model its brain tier allows.
brains.demoChoice: Use the demo brain in this browser instead. It follows plain orders (hold, move, attack, buy) and needs no key.
agents.relay: Your squads now think in this browser, through your {provider} key.
agents.demo: Your squads now run the demo brain in this browser.
agents.server: Your squads are back with this server's agents.
agents.paused: This page was hidden, so its agents stopped. Squads keep their last orders.
agents.stopped: Your agents stopped: {reason}. Squads keep their last orders.
agents.skipped: A squad could not think this time: {reason}. It keeps its last order.
trouble.rate_limited: the provider is limiting this key
trouble.not_your_seat: the relay does not know this seat
trouble.join: the agent could not join the match
noServer: No connection to the game server. Trying again…
voice.insecure: Voice needs https or localhost; this page was opened over plain http. Typing works.
lobby.friend: A friend, with a join code
lobby.watch: Let others watch. A spectator sees both sides.
lobby.waitFriend: Waiting for your friend to take the other seat.
lobby.waitReady: The match starts when both commanders are ready.
lobby.full: Both seats in this match are taken.
lobby.noRoom: There is no match with this code. It may have ended, or the server was restarted.
lobby.noWatching: This match is not open to spectators.
lobby.busy: The server is running as many matches as it can. Try again in a while.
lobby.unprotected: There are no accounts and nothing is encrypted. Anyone on this network who has the code can take the free seat, and the traffic can be read on the network. Each seat is kept by this browser. Voice needs this computer or https, so a friend on another machine types.
lobby.localOnly: This address works only on this computer: start the server with {command} to let a friend in.
lobby.left: The other commander has left the match. Their squads keep their last orders.
lobby.about.easy: Slow to buy, fields few squads, and leaves your headquarters alone for five minutes.
lobby.about.normal: Buys at a human pace and attacks after a few minutes.
lobby.about.standard: Buys the moment it can and attacks at once.
lobby.hostOnly: Type the host password above to make a match. If a friend invited you, use their join code below instead.
lobby.guessing: Too many wrong join codes. Wait a minute and try again.
lobby.hostAbout: This game is open to the internet, so only its host can start a match. Type the host password once; this browser remembers it. A friend who was sent a link does not need it.
